what_happened: The job was meant to restore the records-history design and decision from an archive branch, renumbering D112 to D111. It touched three files: the design doc, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md. The producer made no change. Its report was sent back and still did not show the acceptance criteria met or reported: the renumbered design, the new D111 entry, no leftover D112 references, the two changelog entries, and only three paths changed. It also did not report running the `git diff --stat`, `git status` and `git diff` checks. The job ended failed with no partial result.
cause: The request relied on a mechanical copy from an archive ref with a decision renumbering. Nothing confirmed beforehand that the producer could read that ref, or that the numbers and files it names exist on this branch. Nothing turned the copy and renumber into a scripted step. When the producer did nothing, the system sent it back for a report instead of finding the blocker, such as an unreadable ref or a number clash. The job then failed with no record of why no change was made.
prevention: Add an admission or preflight check for restore-from-ref jobs. It would confirm that the named ref and paths resolve in the producer's checkout, that the target decision number is free, and that the source text has the expected D112 references. It would also give the producer a deterministic restore-and-renumber helper. A producer that ends with an empty diff would fail at once with the reason (ref unreadable, path missing, number taken). It would not be sent back for another report.
proposed_request: Restore the records-history design and its accepted decision from the archive branch archive/next4-2026-10-23, renumbered as D111. First check that the ref is readable here and that D111 is the next free number after D110. If either check fails, stop and report which one failed. Otherwise: (1) docs/design/records-history.md should match the archived file except that every D112 becomes D111, with any state that differs on this branch adjusted. (2) docs/decisions.md gets a D111 entry after D110, with the archived D112 text, status accepted, citing the BRIEF.md addenda of 2026-10-23. It must have no D112 entry and must not contain the archived spec job's D111. (3) CHANGELOG.md gets the archive's two records-history entries under [Unreleased], with D112 changed to D111 and no spec-job entries. Change only those three files. Run git status and git diff --stat to confirm exactly three paths changed, and report the output.
